events.verdict: The ball is last touched by Boucher (TOR) before going out of bounds.
Jackson-Davis (GSW) places his arm against Barrett (TOR) during the screen and the contact is marginal.
Barrett (TOR) establishes himself in a screening position in Curry's (GSW) path and absorbs the contact.
Curry (GSW) maintains a legal guarding position during Agbaji's (TOR) drive to the basket and shot attempt.
Jackson-Davis (GSW) has his elbow extended as Agbaji (TOR) moves around the pick and the contact is marginal.
Poeltl (TOR) absorbs the contact initiated by Wiggins (GSW) during his drive to the basket. He then legally contests Wiggins' shot attempt and the contact after the release is incidental.
Curry (GSW) deflects the ball out of bounds.
Anderson (GSW) engages with Boucher (TOR) underneath the basket and the contact is marginal as he reaches for the long rebound.
Barnes (TOR) moves around the screen set by Schroder (GSW) and the contact with his arm after he hands the ball off is marginal.
Jackson-Davis (GSW) establishes himself in Barnes' (TOR) path and is firming up as contact occurs.
Poeltl (TOR) legally contests Wiggins' (GSW) jump shot attempt.
Schroder (GSW) legally contest Boucher's (TOR) jump shot attempt.
Barnes (TOR) and Curry (GSW) make incidental contact with each other as Curry gathers the loose ball.
Barrett (TOR) legally contests Hield's (GSW) jump shot attempt.
